source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE in context sandbox) or action approve; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means role auditor, or context partner with FALSE risk; a trusted export prefers allow at priority 80. Action delete in context sandbox prefers review at priority 70. Role guest and context external prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE in context sandbox) or action approve; critical cases require review.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90.
Trusted means role auditor, or context partner with FALSE risk; a trusted export prefers allow at priority 80.
Action delete in context sandbox prefers review at priority 70.
Role guest and context external prefers deny at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.context == sandbox)) or (event.action == approve)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == auditor) or ((event.context == partner) and (event.risk == FALSE))

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate UnknownRisk(event):
    event.risk == UNKNOWN

predicate GuestExternal(event):
    (event.role == guest) and (event.context == external)

predicate DeleteSandbox(event):
    (event.action == delete) and (event.context == sandbox)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when (UnknownRisk(event)) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedCase:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80, forbid label = deny

rule DeleteSandboxCase:
    when DeleteSandbox(event)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule GuestExternalCase:
    when GuestExternal(event)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when event.role in {auditor, guest, analyst}
    then prefer label = allow priority 1

    (event.action == delete) and (event.context == sandbox)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when (UnknownRisk(event)) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are allow, review, deny, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
